decision: Reproduce the crash with a persistent minimal Xml.parse program
reason: The broad suite removes its temporary directory and did not identify whether compilation or the generated program crashed
evidence: Both bytecode and native hxhx exited 139 after expression-macro expansion; the generated out.exe ran and printed ok
result: The fault belongs to compiler execution after generation, not Xml.parse in the generated application

decision: Classify strings before probing the structural Array carrier
reason: OCaml strings can have the same three-word block size used by the Array carrier, and reading their bytes as Obj fields is unsafe
evidence: The macOS crash stack ended in caml_obj_tag from HxAnon.get while JsonPrinter called dynamic string cca
result: The existing String dispatch moved ahead of Array probing with no new compiler semantics

decision: Extend the existing XML portable fixture with a three-word dynamic string
reason: A public Haxe-level regression proves the unsafe runtime shape without coupling the test to OCaml implementation details
evidence: xml_parse_basic calls dynamic cca on a 20-byte string and expects code point 48
result: Focused compile, Dune build, execution, and output comparison pass

decision: Accept broad proof through the original Xml.parse checkpoint
reason: A later independent assertion must not obscure evidence for the reported native crash
evidence: The rebuilt prebuilt target suite passed Int64, printed and completed the Xml.parse and Xml.createElement checkpoints, then failed because typed_modules is 10 while a later check expects 11
result: The signal-139 regression is fixed; the later type-only graph count needs separate ownership
